characterDescription: Blodwen Balchder, the young woman EXACTLY as in the reference: youthful oval face, warm fair skin, large grey-blue eyes, auburn brown side-swept hair in one thick braid over HER RIGHT shoulder (viewer's LEFT), same loose side locks. Same square-necked black long-sleeved medieval dress with muted gold curling floral embroidery on bodice and cuffs, same small oval gold medallion at center neckline. Preserve her youthful face, age, hairstyle and proportions; no new jewelry.

panels.gesture: Offene Handflächen, erläuternde Gestik, aufmerksamer Blick.
panels.generationDirection: Speaking and explaining: attentive eyes, mouth mid-sentence, one open palm offering an explanation, other hand making a small conversational gesture.

panels.gesture: Warmes Lächeln, kleine offene Begrüßung mit einer Hand.
panels.generationDirection: Friendly greeting: warm closed-mouth smile, one hand raised in an open-palmed greeting at shoulder height, relaxed shoulders.

panels.gesture: Fröhliche Augen, offen lachender Mund, Hand locker vor dem Mund.
panels.generationDirection: Wholehearted laughter: joyful narrowed eyes, open laughing mouth, one hand loosely near the mouth, other across upper abdomen.

panels.gesture: Finger ans Kinn, seitlicher Blick nach oben, leicht gerunzelte Brauen.
panels.generationDirection: Thoughtful puzzling: fingertips under chin, eyes glancing upward sideways, gently knitted brows.

panels.gesture: Eine Braue hochgezogen, prüfender Blick, verschränkte Arme.
panels.generationDirection: Skeptical suspicion: one eyebrow raised, narrowed appraising sideways gaze, pursed lips, folded arms.

panels.gesture: Weite Augen, kleiner offener Mund, beide Hände spontan angehoben.
panels.generationDirection: Startled surprise: wide eyes, small open mouth, both open hands lifted beside upper chest.

panels.gesture: Halb geschlossene Augen, angespannter Mund, abwinkende Hand.
panels.generationDirection: Annoyed disapproval: half-lidded eyes, taut mouth, one hand waving dismissively outward, other at waist.

panels.gesture: Direkter Blick, aufrecht, Faust ruhig vor der Brust.
panels.generationDirection: Quiet determination: focused direct eyes, firm closed mouth, upright posture, one clenched hand steadily before chest.

panels.gesture: Gerunzelte Brauen, tadelnder Mund, Zeigefinger nach vorn.
panels.generationDirection: Angry confrontation: deeply knitted brows, mouth delivering a forceful rebuke, pointing forward, torso leaning slightly forward.
